name: BOC Hong Kong (Holdings) Limited
summary: BOC Hong Kong (Holdings) Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, delivering a comprehensive suite of banking and related financial solutions to both corporate and individual clients across Hong Kong, mainland China, and international markets. Its operations are structured into four primary segments: Personal Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, and Insurance. The firm provides diverse deposit accounts, including savings, current, and time options, alongside mortgage plans, payroll administration, corporate deposit schemes, and electronic cheque services. It also facilitates cross-border financial transactions and remittance services for its varied customer base. Furthermore, the company offers a range of investment products such as securities, mutual funds, foreign exchange, precious metals, FX margin trading, bonds, and structured products, in addition to business and personal loans. Its insurance offerings span business and accident protection, medical, travel, leisure, family, and personal life coverage. Additional services include safe deposit boxes, e-Bill functionalities, and payment processing. The institution also provides wealth management, overdraft facilities, private banking, account opening, payment and collection, digital banking, various lending options, and extensive cross-border services. Established in 1917 and headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, BOC Hong Kong (Holdings) Limited operates as a subsidiary of BOC Hong Kong (BVI) Limited.
